mr_title: managed settings: fix stale cache case when moving to unavailable

expected_issues.title: Stale managed policy dropped on a transient refresh failure
expected_issues.description:
On a failed refresh ('unavailable': timeout, 401/403, 429, 5xx) the cached managed-settings response is only retained while it is not yet expired; once stale, the enterprise policy is dropped and the client silently falls back to unmanaged defaults.

A transient failure of the policy endpoint is not evidence that the organisation withdrew its managed settings. With this change, after the one-hour cache lifetime any failed fetch returns `managedSettings: undefined`, removing enforced settings (e.g. telemetry endpoints, feature restrictions) until the next successful call. The last successful policy should be kept (with its original timestamp so it is still refetched); only an affirmative answer (200/404) should replace or clear it.
